blocks.text: CYCLES OF PROPHECY— ‘‘The Lord, time angel of the old Testament foretold exact events beforehand. The flood forecast 120 years in advance!” (Gen. 6:3) — ‘‘The Egyptian judgment predicted 400 years ahead!’’ (Gen. 15:13-14) — ‘‘The entrance into Canaan 40 years before! (Nums. 14:33-34) — ‘‘The return to Babylon foreknown 70 years! (Dan. 9:2) — ‘‘The death of Messiah foretold 483 years before!’’ (Dan. 9:25-26) — ‘‘Jesus prophesied of His own resurrection to occur in 3 days!’’ (Matt. 12:40) — ‘‘Jesus foretold at the budding of the Fig Tree (Israel in their homeland) that He would return in the same generation although He did not give the exact date! — The end of the millennium foreseen as one thousand years!’’ (Rev. 20:7) — ‘‘The Lord actually set dates for the other events above so we may realize He also will reveal the times of the end of the age! The most important events ever!

THE FUTURE— The 153 year cycle - ‘‘It is also an elective number. In Bible times ever so many 153 years an elect person would be chosen to fulfill God’s plan in his ministry, prophet, king, etc.’’ — St. John 21:11, “Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, a ‘hundred and fifty and three:’ — Now man has been in rebellion since the era of Christ, about 2,000 years! — And it just so happens the number 13 is the only number these fishes can be multiplied by to fit in this Gentile time frame! — So we take 13 X 153 = 1989, and this reveals the beginning of the end in prophecy! The year 1989 concerned great changes worldwide! The most important since the Jews went back to their homeland!’’ — Vr. 9, “Shows Jesus had a fish on the fire! If it were more it would still represent Israel going through the future fires of tribulation! — If we add it and multiply 13 x 154 = 2001-2! — If you take the number we multiplied by and add 13 to 1989 = 2001-2! — The first part between 1989-2002 is ‘Gentile time.’ And the last part is Jewish time!’’ (Tribulation, etc.)

CONTINUING— ‘‘Also if we add up the number 1 plus 5 plus 3 we have the number 9. Also if we add up the important year 1989! 1 plus 9 is 10, plus 8 is 18, plus 9 is 27, and 2 plus 7 is 9! Now watch this, if we add the 2 nines together we have 18. And 1 plus 8 is 9! — We have 3 nines! If we add the 1 fish on the fire as a number we have the year 1999! — You can count on it the years 1989-99 the world’s greatest events will take place! — Even with out adding the 1 we came out with 999, and the 3 nines occur only once in this whole century! And it occurs in the year 1999 ! — Nine is the number of judgment and because there is 3 of them it projects intensified judgment of great scope!’’ — ‘‘Abraham was ‘99’ when Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities of of the plain went up in a holocaust of fire!’’ (Gen. 17:1 - Gen. 19:24) — ‘‘Jesus could definitely be speaking to us (read Luke 17:29-30) — (Rev. 18:8-10, 18). — “‘So if these numerical values are trying to tell us we are nearing the great day of destruction, then the church leaves much earlier than the occurrence of Armageddon!’’ — ‘‘Concerning the catching away, Paul said, Behold, I show you a mystery! (I Cor. 15:51-52) And surely that is what we have written here! — One to be studied and watched with anticipation. Jesus did not intend for the saints to be ignorant of the times or the season!” (I Thess. 5:4)

THE 6000 YEARS PROPHECY— St. John 21:8, ‘unveils something else. It shows they dragged the net of fishes 200 cubits (about 300 ft.). And the only number to really fit this is 20 x 300! And that gives us the 6000 years of mankind in his great struggle through the ages! Look at this! The number 20 is always associated to trouble, problems and struggle! Do we have a Scripture to match this? Yes. Job 14:1, ‘Man is of a few days and full of trouble!’’ Vr. 2, says, ‘“‘he cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: and also that he fleeth as a shadow, and continueth not!’’ Vr. 5, “depicts his days and months are determined! And God has appointed how far he will go! Vr. 13, Man is appointed a set time!’’

CONTINUING— ‘‘As we noted from the years 1989-2001-2, the number 1 means unity, number 2 means division. So this could be the ‘uniting’ of the Jews in the Jubilee, and then the ‘dividing’ up of the land in Israel for the 12 tribes! And Jesus will again rule over them in the millennium!’’ — “‘So we definitely see attached to the 153 fishes in the net and the 1 on the fire is first the supernatural is associated to it in the abundance of the catch! — And also miracles attached to it! — The future is associated to it! And guidance and direction (right side) is to! — Israel in the fire of tribulation foretold! — Time was associated to it!’’ (St. John 21:3-4) — “The night and the morning! — So also as we saw time dimensions were given to us of the future! — Vr. 7 reveals just as Jesus caught Peter off guard (no clothes) he will catch the people off guard (by surprise) when He returns again! — According to the Scriptures, Jesus is the spirit of Prophecy, and He gave a real significance concerning the revelation of all of this! There are other things associated to this chapter, but we want to continue and see what will fit in concerning the time measures we spoke of!’’

TIME ANGEL IN PROPHECY— “‘As we have seen from the beginning of this Jesus calls time in exact numerical values. A certain day, or year or number was given for a reason to reveal a time, pattern and season for His elect! Now let’s review some events that shall arrive in prophecy and could very well fit into the years 1989-99-2001-2’’ — ‘‘For one thing in 1989 we saw the signification of the iron and clay beginning to melt together, when Russia’s leader met with the Pope! (Dan. 2:41) and the beginning of Rev. 13:1. Now from this date on through the 90’s the complete revived Roman Empire (United Europe) will evidently occur! — Later we should see sudden and drastic changes between Russia and its satellite nations during the 90’s leading finally to Ezek. 38. At some point in the 90’s Babylon harlots and the Vatican will mount the beast controlling all nations for a moment! The anti-Christ will rule the Jews also because the Vatican system has trillions in hidden treasure; and it is not all in currency! (will explain later) — The U.S.A. will finally be caught up in a Jesus and Mary worship! As the woman in Rev. 17 rises to control even in this country giving orders to a false prophet leader! — Also the Vatican is secretly negotiating treaties with every nation! Also is working through Satan’s masterpiece, the ecumenical movement! A sign we see as more Protestant groups are now visiting the Pope! The future is taking shape!”

CONTINUING— ‘‘During the time frame we gave the Jews will make an agreement with a false messiah! Also it seems during this time Daniel’s 70th week will begin! And it is my opinion the Translation could take place during the time we spoke of! We shall also see plagues, famine and disease sweep across the earth! — Currency will finally be illegal to use as the mark of the beast rises! — Prominent signs are already signalling to us these two events are on the horizon! During the time measures we spoke of will come inflationary-depression and a burst of great prosperity! From electronic lasers and computers a world of fantasy will be created for the masses! — Super pleasure will control this planet! — People will be worshiping the image statue of the beast. And the United States make a system like unto this Roman prince, and his dictator stamp will be issued not only here, but worldwide!

CONTINUING— ‘‘A super highway of electronic radar control for cars will appear! — Visions of the Virgin Mary will continue to appear along with all kinds of false religion seducing the nations into Rev. 17.’’ — ‘‘In this ‘time frame’ the U.S.A. could be nearing its last presidents. The same concerning the Popes! And the same for Russia’s future! — The mammoth quakes ever seen in history will occur — also including the great quakes predicted for the Los Angeles and California region!... Also the sea shall cover many of its cities in this generation! — We must mention a world food shortage (famine) of severe conditions will emerge in proportion as in the days of Joseph!... Everyone will receive a code mark or receive no rations!

FUTURE CONTINUING— The time measures we gave the four apocalyptic horses will speed across the earth!’’ (Rev. 6) — We will see drugs, crime wave conditions, violence as never before. Great apostasy will arise and a mighty restoration revival will be to the elect sweeping them up heavenward!... New trends and inventions will change our whole society in new things and in new directions’... Space will reveal unusual mysteries! Also new signs will be seen in the heaven, in the sea and in the earth! — It is very possible an Atomic war will occur in the same time frame mentioned at the start New York and the east coast could be no more! — Also huge asteroids will fall before or by the ending of this century! — Finally the earth undemeath will be heating up! The heavens above will catch on fire! The people of this planet will be caught in an inferno as the earth shakes and the axis shift leveling city after city! — All of this could well take place in the time measures we have given! Let us watch and pray. Scores of other events could be written, but this is enough to waken His people!’’
